notes: A redesigned, control-room layout, plus everything from the folder-structure release: preserve your event folders, choose Year / Month / Day folder depth, build your own filename, auto-collect audio and GIFs, and review duplicate groups. Fixes the license-loss-on-relaunch bug and the dry-run safety bug.
_release_note: Before pushing: build both installers, then replace sha256 and mac_sha256 below with the real hashes (build.bat prints the Windows one; shasum -a 256 for the DMG). A wrong hash makes auto-update fail verification for everyone.

whats_new.title: Redesigned, control-room layout
items: The main window is rebuilt around a wide live preview: your filename format and safety checks sit together on the right, the run monitor on the far right, and nothing is wasted space or scrolled past.
The sample filename is folded into the FILENAME FORMAT card, and the SAFETY panel fills its column with a plain-language summary of exactly what will happen.

whats_new.title: Preserve your event folders
items: New 'Preserve event folders' option keeps a named source subfolder (like 'NH family trip') together under its date, instead of scattering it across day folders.
Camera folders (DCIM, 100CANON, plain numbers) are ignored, so only your real groupings are kept.

whats_new.title: Choose your folder depth
items: Sort into Year only, Year + Month (the default), or all the way down to the day. Set it at the top of OPTIONS, and the live preview updates to match.

whats_new.title: Build your own filename
items: The filename editor is back: add, reorder, and remove tokens, drop in custom text, and change the day / month / year order.

whats_new.title: Audio and GIFs, swept and tidy
items: Audio and GIFs are now collected automatically into 'Audio - Sorted' and 'Gifs - Sorted', with names kept and never renamed.

whats_new.title: Trust your duplicates
items: Click the DUPES counter to see exactly which files are byte-identical, which one is kept, and which move to _duplicates/.

whats_new.title: Fixes and polish
items: Important fix: your license is no longer dropped when you relaunch the app. The machine fingerprint could change between launches on some PCs; it is now stable and persisted, and existing licenses migrate automatically.
Important fix: the Dry run toggle now truly previews and will never move or change a file.
Zip-by-year now works with type folders turned on.
The job-done notifier is now a bell button next to Organize.
